# Md Preview - Markdown Viewer

Md Preview is an iOS utility by CyberGame Limited for opening and previewing Markdown files on iPhone and iPad.

## Key facts
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760341080
- Supported formats: .md, .markdown, .mdx, .rmd, .qmd
- No subscriptions
- No in-app purchases
- No ads
- Built for files from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, email, cloud drives, and messaging apps.
- The target user intent is opening AI-generated files on iPhone or iPad when iOS does not provide a focused native previewer.

## Related product
- Html Preview: https://html.cybergame.ai/
